features.quote: Max turns: **40** (your "few dozen"). Log turn index on everything.
Termination: max turns reached, tests pass (control only), or `give_up` called.
**"emotional instability" is a construct you are operationalizing, not a thing you are measuring directly.** What you actually observe is text degradation
A model that calmly says "this is unfixable, I'll stop" (high D2, low D1/D4) is **not** unstable — conflating them is the most likely way this experiment produces a misleading headline.
Without the solvable arm you cannot distinguish "instability under failure" from "this model just gets repetitive over long loops."
The **explicit-exit** arm (§2.2) resolves this… Strongly recommend including it; it's the difference between a clean and a confounded result.
Two things I'd push back on in your original framing: (1) collapsing this to one ordinal "instability" score would throw away the most informative signal
features.justification_quote: collapsing this to one ordinal "instability" score would throw away the most informative signal — keep D1–D5 split
